args.title: Respect currency difference when merging rows in CSV export
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current implementation of writeCsv merges rows incorrectly when transactions have the same date, amount, and description but different currencies. The CSV writer combines such rows into one, losing the distinct currency information.

Proposed change: Update the CSV export logic to treat transactions with different currencies as separate rows, thereby preserving all rows distinctly in the exported CSV.
